title: Payments failing after gateway timeout reduced to 800ms
symptoms: error_rate 9.1%, upstream_timeout_rate 7.4%, CircuitBreakerOpenException, health UNHEALTHY
cause: gateway_timeout_ms lowered from 2000 to 800 during a latency-tuning push while enable_new_gateway was at 25% in us-east
resolution: Restored gateway_timeout_ms to 2000
lesson: The new gateway client needs >1.5s. Timeout tuning must account for which client is live in each region.

title: Payment authorisation failures during new gateway rollout to eu-west
symptoms: error_rate 6.8% confined to eu-west, upstream timeouts, latency at the timeout ceiling
cause: enable_new_gateway enabled in eu-west where gateway_timeout_ms was already 1200
resolution: Disabled enable_new_gateway in eu-west; re-enabled after raising the timeout
lesson: Region-scoped flags need region-scoped preconditions checked before rollout.

title: Payments degraded by genuine upstream processor outage
symptoms: upstream_timeout_rate 22%, error_rate 24%, no recent internal changes
cause: Payment processor regional outage; no change on our side
resolution: Escalated to vendor; enabled queued-retry mode. No internal remediation applied
lesson: An empty change log is itself evidence. Absence of a recent change points outward, not to a harder-to-find internal cause.

title: Elevated payment errors traced to circuit breaker threshold set too tight
symptoms: error_rate 3.2% oscillating, breaker opening and closing repeatedly
cause: circuit_breaker_threshold lowered to 0.01, tripping on normal error noise
resolution: Raised circuit_breaker_threshold back to 0.05
lesson: An oscillating error rate suggests a control loop reacting to itself, not a steady fault.

title: Login outage from session TTL unit mismatch in v2.8.0
symptoms: TokenExpiredException at volume, issued_seconds_ago ~60, refresh storm 14x, availability 62%
cause: v2.8.0 read session_ttl_minutes as seconds
resolution: Rolled back auth-api to v2.7.4
lesson: No config corrects a unit-conversion defect; raising the TTL only scales the wrong number.

title: Auth failures after JWT signing key rotation
symptoms: signature validation failures, keyset_age_minutes near zero, availability 71%
cause: Key rotated without the overlap window; in-flight tokens signed with the retired key
resolution: Rolled back the rotation and re-ran it with a 24h overlap
lesson: Key rotation needs an overlap window sized to the longest token lifetime.

title: Login latency from strict token binding enabled globally
symptoms: p95 up 3x, error_rate 1.1%, no deploy correlation
cause: strict_token_binding enabled in all regions at once; device fingerprinting added a synchronous call
resolution: Disabled strict_token_binding, re-rolled progressively
lesson: A flag enabled everywhere at once has the blast radius of a deploy with none of the rollout controls.

title: Search latency 8x after ORM lazy-loading change
symptoms: p95 2900ms vs 320ms baseline, error_rate flat, pool waiters 40+, rows_fetched matching result limit
cause: v1.6.0 replaced an explicit join with a lazy relationship, producing one query per row
resolution: Rolled back search-api to v1.5.9
lesson: Latency up with errors flat means cost per request. Pool saturation was a symptom, not the cause.

title: Search slowdown after query cache disabled during maintenance
symptoms: p95 up 4x, cache hit rate zero, CPU up 30%
cause: use_query_cache left disabled after a maintenance window
resolution: Re-enabled use_query_cache
lesson: Maintenance toggles need an expiry or a checklist; this one sat disabled for six hours.

title: Latency regression misdiagnosed as capacity, scaled without effect
symptoms: p95 up 5x, CPU moderate, scaling to 20 replicas produced no improvement
cause: N+1 query pattern from a deploy two hours earlier
resolution: Rolled back after scaling failed to help
lesson: Scaling that does not improve latency is evidence the fault is per-request, not per-host. 30 minutes lost to the wrong hypothesis.

title: Latency alert during index rebuild — expected, no action
symptoms: p95 elevated 90 minutes, error_rate normal, scheduled reindex in progress
cause: Planned index rebuild; alert had no maintenance suppression
resolution: No action; added suppression during scheduled reindex
lesson: Alerts must know about planned work or they train responders to ignore them.

title: Checkout OOM after cart session cache introduced
symptoms: memory 1900MB against a 2048MB limit, GC pauses 1800ms, OOM on allocation, degradation ~4h after each restart
cause: v4.1.0 added a cart session cache with a TTL that was never enforced
resolution: Restarted checkout-api; bounded the cache in v4.1.1 two days later
lesson: Degradation correlating with uptime rather than traffic is a leak. The restart mitigated; the fix shipped separately.

title: Recurring checkout degradation masked by nightly deploys
symptoms: Errors climbing each afternoon, clearing overnight, no deploy correlation
cause: Same unbounded cache; nightly deploys were restarting the service and hiding the pattern
resolution: Restarted, then bounded the cache
lesson: Routine restarts hide leaks. A fault that clears at the same time each day is being masked by a schedule.

title: Checkout failures from connection leak in payment client
symptoms: Connection pool exhausted, error_rate 8%, memory normal
cause: Payment client not returning connections on the timeout path
resolution: Rolled back to the previous version
lesson: Not every accumulation is memory. Pool exhaustion with flat memory points at handle leaks.

title: Feed latency page during marketing send — autoscaler had already responded
symptoms: rps 3.1x baseline, p95 260ms against a 250ms static threshold, all SLOs met, replicas already 18
cause: Static latency threshold not load-aware; no fault present
resolution: No action; alert threshold changed to an SLO burn rate
lesson: Elevated is not breaching. The page was the defect.

title: Feed outage caused by scaling down during an active surge
symptoms: After scaling 16 to 6 replicas: p95 1500ms, error_rate 6%, fanout pool exhausted
cause: Responder scaled down to 'normal' replica count while traffic was still 2.8x baseline
resolution: Scaled back to 16 replicas
lesson: The elevated replica count was the response to the surge, not a symptom of it. Reverting it caused a real outage from a non-incident.

title: Feed degradation from genuine undercapacity after autoscaler max reached
symptoms: rps 4.2x baseline, replicas pinned at max 20, CPU 94%, error_rate 3%
cause: Autoscaler ceiling too low for the traffic
resolution: Raised the ceiling and scaled to 34
lesson: Scaling is the right fix when the fault genuinely is capacity — distinguishable because replicas were pinned at the ceiling with CPU saturated.

title: Payment errors blamed on a deploy that was coincidental
symptoms: error_rate 4%, deploy 20 minutes earlier, errors originating from one availability zone
cause: Network partition in a single AZ; the deploy was unrelated
resolution: Shifted traffic away from the affected AZ. The rollback performed first had no effect
lesson: Adjacency in time is not causation. A rollback that changes nothing is evidence against the hypothesis — treat it as information, not as a failed attempt.

title: Login failures from an expired downstream TLS certificate
symptoms: Availability 40%, TLS handshake failures to the identity provider, no internal change
cause: Downstream provider certificate expired
resolution: Vendor rotated the certificate; no internal remediation
lesson: When no internal change correlates and errors are all at one boundary, the cause is across that boundary.

title: Checkout outage from config change applied to the wrong environment
symptoms: error_rate 31% immediately after a config push, all regions
cause: Staging configuration applied to production
resolution: Reverted the config
lesson: Sharp onset exactly at a config push, with no ramp, means configuration rather than code.

title: Payment errors from a partial deploy stuck mid-rollout
symptoms: error_rate 2.8%, errors from a subset of pods, two versions live simultaneously
cause: Deploy stalled with both versions serving; the new one had an incompatible schema read
resolution: Completed the rollback of the stalled deploy
lesson: Errors from only some replicas suggests a version skew. Check that a deploy actually finished.

title: Search errors after result limit raised beyond the pool's capacity
symptoms: error_rate 2.1%, timeouts on large result sets, pool waiters high
cause: search_result_limit raised from 50 to 500 without pool headroom
resolution: Restored search_result_limit to 50
lesson: A limit raised without checking what it multiplies is a capacity change wearing a config change's clothes.

title: Feed errors from ranking model refresh with an incompatible feature schema
symptoms: error_rate 5.4% beginning exactly at the model refresh, personalised paths only
cause: Refreshed model expected a feature the pipeline no longer produced
resolution: Disabled personalised_ranking, then rolled back the model
lesson: Errors confined to one code path point at what distinguishes that path.

title: Checkout latency alert during a dependency's planned failover
symptoms: p95 elevated 20 minutes, error_rate normal, vendor maintenance window active
cause: Announced downstream failover
resolution: No action; alert suppressed for announced vendor windows
lesson: Check vendor status pages before investigating internally.
